## Pre-Merge Checklist

- [ ] My branch follows the naming convention (`feature/person[1-3]-*`, `fix/*`, `research/*`, `docs/*`).
- [ ] Changes are scoped to my component ownership or coordinated with owners.
- [ ] If shared contracts (`shared-types` or `action-schema`) were modified, all team members have approved.
- [ ] No secrets, credentials, or API keys are committed.
- [ ] No large model weights or binary blobs are committed to Git.
- [ ] No real user data or authentic personal data is added to tests or fixtures (synthetic only).
- [ ] Associated documentation in `docs/` has been updated if applicable.
- [ ] Code conforms to `.editorconfig` formatting rules.
